full_page.content:
1931, November
FR. SOLANUS NOTEBOOK, NO. 5
Page 3 Cont.
Nov. 30 Kauffan's grand-child - Cath. Austin - 10 - Strepticoctic poison in blood-stream - 15 weeks in bed - "hopeless" ... making novena to Imm. Conception. +July 7 most peaceful .. 1932.
James Sheridan of Marmora, Ont. writes He has asthma, cancer & arthritis -
S. Lupo - 10 - as many as 20 fits a day.
1931, December
Page 4
Dec. 1 Mercier Case 260 lbs ... +
Mrs. McDonald non Cath - 3 years deaf.
Agnes Dydert - 50 - supporting five children - poor husband - sinus .one son V. wants to return to Seminary .. .
4 Peter Morgan - 52 - High Bl .- pres're enrolled by phone Nov. 27th did improve but To-day very low; Sister enrolls him a perpetual member 3:10 p.m. Phones at 10:30 a.m. "Br. better when S. got home .. Had good night," Deo G.
8 8:30, a.m. Arthur I. Flanagan enrolled by phone - missing since Wed. 2nd. Called up on phone 10 minutes after same morning.
Margaret Kelly - 50 - quite out of her mind .... Sister comes back from bakery just in time to prevent patrol from taking her away ....
Cancer of mouth reported cured
Page 5 Dec. 6 Cecelia Soroski - 25 - inward cancer enrolled To-day - "can't sleep or rest with the pain"
John Uller - 52 - failing ... Anxious lest friend who offers to back him lose by so doing ... Enrolled To-day ... $5.00 for the Missions. Was formerly banker in Mt. C. - father of 13 sons & 2 daughters ...
James Sands - 18 - of Co. Down, Ireland - operated in June for tuber- cular bone in leg, threatened with loss of leg now - Enrolled To-day as a perpetual member.
Catherine Kelly - 60 - cancer & liver - Drs. give up all hope of recovery.
